groups.rationale: Reviewed c89335a2a Android integration against checkpoint a22c3ca7. ADR-0206 adds a partial guest profile without a new Ash domain, resource owner, physical host or deployment topology. Existing Peach Version ownership, disabled fleet state and database authority remain unchanged. Reference rollout and ordinary CLI observations do not qualify Android or widen the native editor, isolation or recovery matrix. Additional 2d598e3e2 range adds no domain, resource owner, host or placement; prior partial Android and native acceptance boundaries remain.

Preserved checkpoint non-nil GitHub callback guard, per-case Pins/Teams fixtures, 100-case oracles and narrow 600000ms history budget; the 23-test trace timing run does not establish finite deadlines. Pre-pull forced typing failed with 15 unskipped findings and cannot verify merged source. Incoming broad callback rescue changes classification without authority change. Reviewed localized key/admin flashes and partial Android tickets, relay state and workspace controls. Viewer tuple, disconnected browser/admission and stream mismatches remain findings, with generation rollover unimplemented; no merged runtime or typing pass is recorded. Additional 2d598e3e2 source adds display WebSocket adapter/route and hook registration; earlier c893 disconnected endpoint finding is historical. Hook import is still absent and a forward repair is required. Current generation, claim-mode and shared controller-lease integration remain unestablished; no merged browser/runtime pass is recorded. After merge 2ce5d0c4, reviewed the explicit AndroidDisplay module import before its existing hook registration. This removes the missing-reference browser startup defect without changing display authorization, contracts, layout or ADR-0161/partial ADR-0206. Existing handbook Android qualification gaps remain accurate; startup smoke and full feature acceptance are separate.

Reviewed new linux_android_v1 capability row, Android relay preface and bounded display/input codecs under partial ADR-0206. Exported v4 Linux artifact admission does not yet establish the Android capability path; frame/input hook mismatches and malformed stream contract metadata remain findings. Protocol Hegel and codec tests are present without a new passing execution record; the library and both consumers require merged-source gates. Checkpoint Customer evidence retains its original scope. Additional 2d598e3e2 preserves bounded GitHub Link response headers for private rewriting, with a new allowlist assertion present but not executed here. Android socket consumes existing stream contracts without establishing its current-generation or claim-mode integration. Library and both consumer gates remain pending.

Reviewed Android target validation, fixed display port/mark and relay preface connector alongside the checkpoint host-local authority. Guest loopback RFB and vsock bridge are not established by the new TCP connector or policy mark. ADR-0206 and guest/interactive handbook chapters retain authenticated-display and native Firecracker gaps. No merged Lilly test/type result or native isolation, storage or recovery acceptance is claimed; prior bounded Lilly evidence remains at its original revision. Additional 2d598e3e2 changes only Marshall display plumbing and shared GitHub pagination; no Lilly source or host-local transport changed. Earlier Android connector, loopback/vsock and native Firecracker gaps remain open.

Reviewed c89335a2a merge: no Audi, Brady, Ziggy, Galileo, Enrico, Porsche, Lyra or Peach runtime source changed in this incoming range. Relay state adds no deployed service owner or topology. Retained Porsche 108-test zero-Dialyzer result at 1f79f63e6 and checkpoint three-test catalog scope; linguistic, native SSH, browser and physical acceptance remain separate. Additional 2d598e3e2 adds no service runtime or deployed owner; same-origin Marshall display and private GitHub pagination documentation preserve existing separate service/native evidence scope.

Reviewed software-rendered Android guest recipe, persistent AVD state, 600-second intended readiness budget, loopback RFB/vsock bridge and machine fixture under partial ADR-0206. Artifact identity, connector policy and browser path remain unqualified; machine-test presence is not a passing run. Incoming suspension fixture owns its VM and public route after shared enrollment. Preserved checkpoint Windows probe URI repair and passing build/Python static scope with native browser gap; placement and physical recovery claims are unchanged. Additional 2d598e3e2 changes no artifact recipe, fleet configuration or machine fixture. New Marshall endpoint source does not qualify the Android image, native transport, physical recovery or browser journey.

Reviewed complete c89335a2a merge and retained all seven group definitions and upstream source prose. Matrix review distinguishes checkpoint trace-only timing from incoming Android/localization source, records known viewer/browser/codec and contract-metadata findings, and records pre-pull forced typing exit2 with 15 unskipped findings. Existing handbook partial-status and native/editor/linguistic gaps remain; no new handbook chapter change is needed for the merge-review narrative. ADR-0206 generation rollover remains unimplemented and merged consumer gates remain pending. Additional 2d598e3e2 review records source-only WebSocket/hook and GitHub pagination changes, distinguishes historical c893 disconnected findings, and preserves missing native integration and merged test/type gaps. Existing handbook partial scope remains; no additional mapped chapter edit is required for the merge review. Reviewed the narrow post-2ce5d0c4 AndroidDisplay import repair and appended its source-level outcome to the matrix review. No architecture decision or handbook behavior changes; partial ADR-0206 and existing native/browser/runtime evidence limits remain. Root owns the separate syntax/startup smoke.
